Government.Name: ITIDA
Application_Process: Submit registration online via ITAC portal
Submit proposal and budget detailing work packages
Technical review by academic committee
Success_Stories: Successful exports expansion for local software houses
Government.Notes: Excellent non-dilutive funding for technology startups in collaboration with public and private universities.
Steps_For_Any_Project_To_Get_Funded: Register your company on ITIDA portal
Keep your corporate documentation updated
Steps_For_This_Project_To_Get_Funded: Select an academic partner from a local university
Apply for the ITAC joint research grant

Government.Name: ASRT
Government.Funding_Amount: Up to 150,000 EGP for graduation projects
Application_Process: Complete submission on ASRT official portal
Academic evaluation by expert committees
Success_Stories: Many graduation projects turned into successful hardware startups
Intilaac network has incubated over 100 startups
Government.Notes: ASRT is the main science and engineering promoter in Egypt, providing great early funding for students.
Steps_For_Any_Project_To_Get_Funded: Check open calls on ASRT portal
Submit a complete research project proposal
Steps_For_This_Project_To_Get_Funded: Have the academic advisor submit the graduation project details
Follow the budget allocation rules

Government.Name: STDF
Government.Funding_Amount: Up to 2,000,000 EGP depending on grant type
Application_Process: Create account on STDF portal
Submit research proposal and supporting docs
Undergo standard academic peer review
Success_Stories: Establishment of advanced nanotechnology research labs in universities
Government.Notes: STDF is the primary governmental funding arm for scientific research and technology development in Egypt.
Steps_For_Any_Project_To_Get_Funded: Ensure compliance with national scientific research priorities
Apply during specific call windows
Steps_For_This_Project_To_Get_Funded: Formulate a detailed deeptech proposal
Co-apply with a commercial industry partner

Government.Name: MCIT
Eligibility: Tech startups looking for space and training grants
Government.Funding_Amount: Fully funded training and up to 100k EGP seed awards
Application_Process: Apply through the Creativa hub portal
Complete assessments and interviews
Success_Stories: Thousands of certified data scientists and software developers placed
Incubation of regional startups in remote governorates
Government.Notes: Focuses on human capacity building and digital infrastructure development in Egypt.
Steps_For_Any_Project_To_Get_Funded: Enroll in MCIT regional innovation programs
Participate in local startup tracks
Steps_For_This_Project_To_Get_Funded: Submit application for the Creativa seed grants
Present a verified digital solution

Government.Name: Monsha'at
Eligibility: Saudi registered small and medium enterprises
Government.Funding_Amount: Up to 5,000,000 SAR in credit guarantees

Apply through the lending gateway
Connect with participating financial entities
Success_Stories: Over 10,000 SMEs funded through the lending portal
Tomoh scale-ups listing on Nomu parallel market
Government.Notes: Monshaat acts as the central coordinator for Saudi SME growth and financing access.
Steps_For_Any_Project_To_Get_Funded: Keep your corporate compliance and Zakat status updated
Apply through the official portal
Steps_For_This_Project_To_Get_Funded: Complete the SME classification certificate
Apply directly via the SME Lending Gateway

Government.Name: MCIT Saudi Arabia

Submit tech validation and financial projections

Apply for the NTDP grants program
Steps_For_This_Project_To_Get_Funded: Apply for the NTDP Booster or Relocate program

Government.Name: UAE Ministry of Economy

Steps_For_This_Project_To_Get_Funded: Select the SkillUp or ScaleUp track
